items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Ray Bonitas was playing drums... they took me off a... Off a piano... And put me on drums... And they said, what we gonna do with Ray's? Make him a bass player... Ray Bonitas was playing, he was playing string bass

ctx.x: No. No, I don't know that.

He was a sales... He was a... He was a manager. Slim was a sales manager. He had a brother by the name of Ewell Lamar. Who was a piano player. Not a good one, but... He was a piano player. And, uh... After we left... In Biloxi... Ray Bonitas was playing drums. And we went up to... Play up in Jackson, Mississippi. Well, Slim was with... Sales manager for Khan. And what they were trying to do... They were trying to build bands up in Mississippi. School bands, huh? And, uh... Ray Bonitas... When Slim's brother…
